acceptance_status: Automated-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Rust ToolsForm describes all four tools forms: control order, semantic roles, action groups, history clear row/flex/list placement, busy state and sleeping-workspace copy. Native adapters instantiate controls and execute browser services; Views retains its original form structure.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

contracts: Rust now returns a typed form plan for Time Machine, shortcuts, search providers and history. It owns the order and roles of seven editor fields, five choices and fourteen actions, headings, hints and consecutive action group boundaries. The opt-in native builder consumes this plan rather than selecting a page-specific control tree. Views retains its original reference builder.

Rust preserves four timeline action groups, one shortcut group and one provider group at gap 10; history keeps gap 8, flexible period choice, intrinsic clear action, result column gap 4 and initially hidden more group. Busy history reconstruction uses the same disabled clear state as live updates. Choice projection enabled state cannot be overwritten by the generic node enabled flag.

Workspace/profile names are display context only. Sleeping workspace metadata remains UTF-16 through hint concatenation, including partial surrogates. Form description is read-only and cannot reset queries, recording, projected keys or active drafts.

The native adapter retains existing editor callbacks, IME, shortcut recording/key registration, SceneSelect projection and prefix/menu behavior, captured-key action admission, profile/workspace/generation checks, timers and browser-service callbacks. Native shortcut/provider validation, history-clearing authority, persistence and source data remain unchanged.

Five Rust regressions cover the original control/command sequence, balanced action/row topology and spacing, history busy/hidden states, Unicode context/raw UTF-16 and non-mutating form description. A new shared browser regression compares the ordered accessible control names on every tools page and reconstructs history while clearing is busy. Existing Cocoa editor/selection/action, recording, timeline and scene clipping/geometry cases remain in the focused/broad/full gates.

No dependency or browser-service policy was added. Native interaction/container ownership, other forms/status/service wording and full manual/performance/release acceptance remain open. No controlled CPU/GPU/presentation or memory gain is established.

focused_input.inventory_note: Selection metadata reconstructed from completed --gtest_list_tests output; the launcher received the declared filter unchanged. Summary/test-set equality is required by the report.

optional_scenarios.status: Not rerun for this presentation checkpoint. The earlier tools-chrome report retains four default-30-trial passes per backend; none is counted as a current-commit pass.

limits: Native titles/frames and modal/scroll/window/event/focus/AX containers, other forms/panels/layouts and remaining form coordination/service wording remain open. Native browser validation, authority, stores and operations remain explicit adapters.
Manual IME/candidate-window, VoiceOver, global RTL, typography/scale/pixel fidelity, pointer/trackpad, detach/reattach and GPU recovery acceptance remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup or memory improvement is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles were untouched; no release bundle was packaged/signed. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream license/notice acceptance remains open.
